title: Practice Saving Your Work
authorship: Newly authored for Classroom Activities with AI assistance. No external curriculum source or answer key is used.
introduction: Use this short activity to practice a draft backup and part-by-part answer downloads. Your teacher will tell you whether to attach the practice files to Classroom.

blocks.text: Before downloading a Draft Backup, describe what you expect that file to contain. Then download one and describe what happened.
Use the Part Submission button, download a readable copy, and open it. Describe where you found your name and answers.
